description: Mediation Boards Commission - Inviting fresh nominations for the chairman and Mediators of Panel of Mediation of the Administrative District Colombo and 13 Other Administrative Districts
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the appointment of judicial mediators to Mediation Boards, which falls under judicial/law enforcement matters. It involves calling for nominations for judicial officers (mediators) to serve on mediation panels across various districts, which is specifically covered by Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) for court appointments and judicial matters.
